characters.continuity: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003 film), its sequels, and related comic depictions
characters.summary: Hector Barbossa is a cunning and ruthless pirate captain who relies on expert swordsmanship, tactical leadership, and a ruthless willingness to exploit any advantage. In certain appearances, he benefits from an immortal, cursed undead state.

mechanisms: Immunity to mortal wounds while under the Aztec gold curse

weaknesses: Vulnerable to normal mortal injury once the Aztec gold curse is lifted
Arrogance and overconfidence in his immortality or control of situations

depictions.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003 film)
Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End (2007 film)

limitations: Cannot taste food, feel physical pleasure, or die naturally while cursed
Relies heavily on standard 18th-century weaponry and naval equipment

sources.supports: Barbossa's role, sword fighting, and the Aztec gold curse mechanics.
Barbossa's return, navigation, and leadership in sequels.

feats.claim: Fought a prolonged sword duel with Jack Sparrow while affected by the immortality curse.
feats.citation: Climactic duel in Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
feats.depiction: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003 film)

feats.claim: Successfully navigated to Shipwreck Cove and rallied the Brethren Court.
feats.citation: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
feats.depiction: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End (2007 film)

notableResults.citation: Climactic duel in Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
notableResults.note: Lost when Jack shot him with a single pistol ball at the exact moment the curse was lifted.
notableResults.depiction: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003 film)

conditional.ability: Undead immortality and resistance to mortal injury
conditional.dependsOn: Being exposed to moonlight while carrying the cursed Aztec gold
conditional.depiction: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003 film)

unknowns: Extent of magical knowledge beyond operating navigation charts and interacting with supernatural curses.

characters.continuity: Mission: Impossible – Fallout (2018 film) and its preceding/succeeding films in the franchise
characters.summary: Ilsa Faust is a highly trained MI6 operative and combatant who combines exceptional martial arts proficiency, firearm mastery, and deep undercover infiltration skills.
weaknesses: Susceptible to physical exhaustion and standard trauma
limitations: Dependent on standard espionage gear and firearms

sources.supports: Ilsa Faust's combat feats and role in Mission: Impossible – Fallout.

feats.claim: Engaged in close-quarters combat against armed adversaries in London and Paris.

unknowns: Full scope of her hidden MI6 agency assets across every international jurisdiction.

characters.continuity: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003 film), its sequels, and related comic depictions
characters.summary: Captain Jack Sparrow is an eccentric pirate whose combat style relies heavily on improvisational cunning, unorthodox dirty fighting, psychological distraction, and preternatural luck.
weaknesses: Prone to hubris and prioritizing personal survival or rum
Lacks supernatural physical durability in normal form

depictions.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003 film)
Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest (2006 film)

limitations: Frail physical constitution compared to heavily armored or supernatural foes
Relies on standard 18th-century weapons with limited ammunition

sources.supports: Jack Sparrow's introduction, fencing skills, and escape tactics.
Jack's survival feats and encounters with supernatural threats.

feats.claim: Escaped British custody in Port Royal using clever ropework and environment.
feats.citation: Opening sequences of Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
feats.depiction: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003 film)

feats.claim: Dueled Hector Barbossa and landed the decisive shot when the curse was broken.
feats.citation: Climactic battle in Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
feats.depiction: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003 film)

notableResults.citation: Climactic duel in Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
notableResults.note: Won by utilizing a cursed coin to survive a mortal stab before lifting the curse.
notableResults.depiction: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003 film)

unknowns: The true extent of his supernatural luck versus pure coincidence.

characters.continuity: The Bourne Identity (2002 film) and its sequels
characters.summary: Jason Bourne is an amnesiac former CIA black-ops assassin possessing extraordinary combat instincts, extreme situational awareness, and the ability to turn ordinary objects into lethal weapons.
weaknesses: Human physiological limitations against overwhelming gunfire
Occasional psychological trauma and memory triggers
limitations: Vulnerable to bullets and conventional injuries
Requires access to tactical gear or improvised surroundings

sources.supports: Bourne's combat training, amnesia, and martial feats.

feats.claim: Defeated a trained assassin sent to his apartment using a ballpoint pen and hand-to-hand maneuvers.
feats.citation: Apartment fight scene in The Bourne Identity

notableResults.note: Outmaneuvered and fatally wounded the rival assassin in a field.

unknowns: Full extent of Treadstone conditioning impacts under extreme torture.

characters.continuity: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003 film), its sequels, and related comic depictions
characters.summary: Will Turner is a skilled blacksmith and exceptionally talented swordsman who combines traditional European fencing techniques with high physical endurance and moral resolve.

techniques: Precision swordplay (trained by master blacksmithing and self-taught fencing)

weaknesses: Prone to emotional compromise when protecting loved ones

depictions.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003 film)

limitations: Lacks supernatural powers in his standard human form
Relies entirely on physical conditioning and weaponry

sources.supports: Will Turner's introduction, blacksmithing background, and sword duel with Jack Sparrow.

feats.citation: Blacksmith shop scene in Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl

notableResults.note: Duel interrupted by outside interference after a competitive exchange.
